Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using HA-tagged HIV-1 integrase. Quantification was performed using spectral counting (label-free). While the paper discusses acetylation mutations (K258R), the proteomics part of the study was used to identify binding partners, not to map acetylation sites; PRIDE metadata explicitly states 'No PTMs are included in the dataset'.

scope: A mass spectrometry study following immunoprecipitation identifies host factors binding to IN
WT and mutant IN were immunoprecipitated and interacting host proteins were subject to mass spectrometry for identification.
